samples.question: The image is a 32x32 lattice of flat gray blocks, each painted a single random gray level, so the field looks like uniform flat noise. A hidden vertical band was encoded in the VALUE of the gray levels: inside the band every block's level is an exact multiple of 7 (residue 0), outside it the levels are arbitrary. Take each block's gray level MODULO 7 and light up the residue-0 blocks; the band appears. Which vertical band is revealed, the left band L or the right band R? Answer L or R.
